description: Consent, shared bodies, resistance and fragile coalition politics: Jolinar, Jacob/Selmak, Shau’nac and Tanith, Egeria and tretonin, and the Jaffa–Tok’ra alliance.

Breakdown of alliance trust following Alpha Site attack.
